author: PostOakLabs
description: Arithmetic on declared policy. It does not choose the benchmark, does not judge whether the percentage is appropriate, and is not a materiality determination. From a declared benchmark id, a benchmark amount in integer minor units, three percentages in basis points, a required rationale id and a declared rounding rule, it recomputes the overall materiality, the performance materiality and the clearly-trivial threshold, and flags an ordering violation, never correcting it. It ships no default percentage. A missing rationale id, a percentage of zero or above 10000 basis points, or a negative or non-integer amount is refused with an explicit code.

benchmark_id.description: Declared id of the benchmark the amount comes from (not free text)

benchmark_amount.description: Benchmark amount in integer minor units; zero or more

overall_bps.description: Overall materiality as basis points of the benchmark; 1 to 10000

performance_bps.description: Performance materiality as basis points of overall; 1 to 10000

trivial_bps.description: Clearly-trivial threshold as basis points of overall; 1 to 10000

rationale_id.description: Required id of the documented rationale for the benchmark and percentages

rounding_rule.description: Declared rounding rule, half_up or floor; it changes the hash

mcp_tool_definition.description: Arithmetic on declared policy: from a declared benchmark amount, three percentages in basis points, a required rationale id and a rounding rule, recomputes overall, performance and clearly-trivial thresholds and flags an ordering violation. Ships no default percentage, does not choose the benchmark and is not a materiality determination. Refuses a missing rationale id, a percentage of zero or above 10000 basis points, and a negative or non-integer amount. Zero network calls, zero PII.

benchmark_amount.description: Benchmark amount in integer minor units; zero or more

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_planning_materiality

outcome.description: computed, or refused when the input cannot be computed

refusal_reasons.description: Explicit refusal codes, empty when computed

benchmark_id.description: The declared benchmark id, null when none was given

rationale_id.description: The declared rationale id, null when none was given

rounding_rule.description: The declared rounding rule, null when invalid

benchmark_amount.description: The declared benchmark amount, null when invalid

overall_bps.description: The declared overall percentage in basis points, null when invalid

performance_bps.description: The declared performance percentage in basis points, null when invalid

trivial_bps.description: The declared clearly-trivial percentage in basis points, null when invalid

overall_materiality.description: Benchmark times overall_bps under the rounding rule, null when refused

performance_materiality.description: Overall materiality times performance_bps under the rounding rule, null when refused

clearly_trivial_threshold.description: Overall materiality times trivial_bps under the rounding rule, null when refused

performance_not_above_overall.description: Whether performance materiality is at or below overall, null when refused

trivial_not_above_performance.description: Whether the clearly-trivial threshold is at or below performance, null when refused
